title: Moment conditions imply hypercontractivity
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\mu$, let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb{R}$, let $r$ be a positive integer, and let $\rho\ge0$ satisfy $\rho^2\le 1/(2r-1)$. Suppose $\mathbb{E}_{\mu}[X^2]=1$, $\mathbb{E}_{\mu}[X^{2j-1}]=0$ for every integer $j$ with $1\le j\le r$, and, for each such $j$, $\mathbb{E}_{\mu}[X^{2j}]\le (2r-1)^j\binom{r}{j}/\binom{2r}{2j}$. Then for all $a,b\in\mathbb{R}$, the $2r$-norm of $a+\rho bX$ is at most the $2$-norm of $a+bX$.
hypotheses_covered: Finite probability space and probability mass function
Odd moments vanish for every integer j with 1 ≤ j ≤ r
Even moment bound for every integer j with 1 ≤ j ≤ r
